parts.name: Body
parts.Basic_description: The body is the main cylindrical part of the bottle made of polyethylene plastic, typically smooth and slightly flexible.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main container for holding liquids or other substances.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part of the bottle and does not move relative to other parts.

parts.name: Neck
parts.Basic_description: The neck is the narrow upper section of the bottle connecting the body to the lid, made of the same plastic material.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a threaded or smooth surface for attaching the lid and controls the flow of liquid during pouring.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part of the bottle and does not move, but interacts with the lid through screwing or snapping.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is a removable cap made of polypropylene plastic, typically harder than the body material.
parts.Functional_description: It seals the bottle to prevent leakage and contamination, and can be twisted or snapped on and off.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or snap on/off relative to the neck, allowing opening and closing of the bottle.
